title: Investigate and remediate overcounting during interleaved cache warmups affecting enterprise invoices
creator: Maya Patel
description: An enterprise customer reported a sudden 12% spike in billed token usage following a scheduled capacity scale-up in their Dedicated cluster. Initial analysis shows that the billing ledger recorded duplicated token segments during node join/redispatch windows when our prefix cache warmup and prefetch paths interleave with retry/fallback routing. This ticket tracks the end-to-end investigation, customer communication, hotfix rollout, and reconciliation credits/backfill for affected billing periods.
steps_to_reproduce: Simulate Dedicated autoscale: add new inference node to a GPU pool and trigger traffic redistribution
Enable prefix prefetch on the new node so KV cache warmup sends speculative prefetch requests
Send a burst of long-chat streaming requests that cause retry/fallback routing across old and new nodes
Observe metering ingest: look for token segments written twice without idempotency keys and missing "idempotency-propagation" header
root_cause: Race between cache-warmup speculative prefetches and request routing during node join. Prefetch requests were routed through the legacy fallback proxy path which strips our idempotency header, so the metering pipeline saw the warmup-generated tokens as new consumption. Simultaneous retries from client SDKs amplified the double-counting under heavy burst traffic.
mitigation: 1) Temporary mitigation deployed 2026-03-06: disable speculative prefetch for Dedicated autoscale events. 2) Added a short-lived filter in the ingest pipeline to collapse token segments with identical session+offset when arrival time delta < 2s. 3) Issued immediate customer credit and paused further invoice generation for affected tenants while backfill runs.
planned_work: Propagate idempotency header across all proxy/fallback paths (PR #4981)
Make metering ingest dedup window configurable and add conservative default (PR #4985)
Audit and harden prefetch path to include origin metadata so warmups are safely marked (PR #4999)
Create automated backfill job to reconcile duplicated ledgers and apply credits (internal tool update PR #5003)
Add end-to-end integration test that simulates node join + prefetch + retry to prevent regression
rollout_plan: 1) Merge idempotency propagation and prefetch metadata changes to canary cluster (runtime-1.32-canary). 2) Validate metering ingest rejects warmup-marked requests and dedupes legacy duplicates against production backfill sample. 3) Gradually roll to Dedicated customers over 48 hours with monitoring gates. 4) Post-roll credit reconciliation and postmortem publication.
postmortem_actions: Publish incident timeline and RCA to Confluence: /confluence/redwood/metering/2026-03-warmup-overcount
Ship integration test to CI that reproduces node join duplication scenario
Add observability metric: "prefetch_count_tagged" to track warmup-marked prefetches per pool
Update runbook for Dedicated autoscale to include toggle for speculative prefetch
